Otlp.//: OTLP/HTTP base URL of the backend (e.g. GitLab Observability https://<id>.otel.gitlab-o11y.com:14318) or of an optional Collector. /v1/{logs,traces,metrics} is appended.

Resource.//: Defaults for every source. Host and BC instance come from the ingestion URL (/<host>/<instance>/v2/track); Sources overrides per 'host/instance', 'instance' or 'host'.
Resource.//Attributes: Extra resource attributes for every source, e.g. gitlab.project.id (links telemetry to a GitLab project). Sources entries may add their own Attributes.

Mapping.//: BC events with a duration (sign-in, SQL, AL, web services, reports) also become spans for APM views; the log links to its span. All events of one BC operation (client action) share a trace.

HostTelemetry.//: Windows only: metrics and BC event log of the machine the proxy runs on (system.*, bc.server.*, process.*, bcproxy.*).

SqlMonitoring.//: Agentless SQL Server monitoring (DMVs) of the BC database servers, also remote ones (2-tier). Discovered from the BC instances on this machine; more in Servers (name -> connection string). Needs VIEW SERVER STATE for the proxy's identity.

Support.//: GET /support/errors (JSON) and /support/errors/<fingerprint> (Markdown report for the partner/CSP). Local callers only unless LocalOnly is false. TraceUrlTemplate: link to a trace, {traceId} is replaced.

Debug.//: Troubleshooting only: set CaptureDirectory to write raw BC envelopes and exported OTLP JSON to capture-yyyyMMdd.ndjson. Unfiltered (may contain personal data); stops at MaxCaptureBytes.
